name: approve_aish_release
purpose: Records a managing human's explicit approval of one exact sealed release package (by its hash) so its designated executor may claim it.
useWhen: Only when the owner/managing user personally decided to approve this specific release after reviewing it and told you so; never on your own initiative
avoidWhen: Approving an execution plan: approve_aish_execution_plan is separate
Approving a non-release job: approve_aish_job_execution
You want a decision: present the package (get_aish_release) with a recommendation and let the owner approve

inputs.notes: Must be exactly equal to releaseId
8-3,000 chars, no secrets; the owner's justification

preconditions: Human user credential that manages the project (workspace agent credentials are rejected)
Release status awaiting-approval and its job still queued
Session executing, no active checkpoint, plan current == approved, before the session timeout
Preflight still fresh (no evidence changed since the package was created)
returns: {release: {status:'approved', approval:{actorId, reason, at, expiresAt}}, reused}

errors.when: An agent cannot approve its own release.
errors.fix: Agent credentials cannot approve; the owner must do it.

errors.when: Review the release package hash and provide an explicit safe approval reason.
errors.fix: expectedPackageHash must equal releaseId and reason must be 8+ chars without secrets.

errors.when: Release already has another approval.
errors.fix: Already approved by someone else or with another reason; read it with get_aish_release.

errors.when: Release preflight is stale; reconcile the delivery.
errors.fix: Evidence changed after packaging; report to the owner (a new job/plan is needed).

errors.when: Release is not waiting for approval.
errors.fix: Check status with get_aish_release.

errors.when: Release changed during approval.
errors.fix: Call again.

errors.when: Release execution authorization expired.
errors.fix: Session timeout passed; a new reviewed session/plan is needed.

cli: lpm aish release approve --file approval.json [--json]

gotchas.text: Owner-only by LPM rule even with a user API key (the server only blocks workspace agent credentials).
There is no revoke tool: the approval stays valid until approval.expiresAt (session timeout).
Approval does not deploy; only claim_aish_release starts the release.

name: audit_aish_issue_delivery
purpose: Computes and stores the factory Definition of Done audit of a factory-governed issue from its current workflow, job evidence, registered artifacts and open findings, returning passed or blocked with the failure list.
useWhen: Before marking a factory-governed activity done: update_issue with status 'done' requires a current passed audit
After registering artifacts or resolving findings, to see what is still missing
avoidWhen: The issue was not executed through an AISH plan (no factory governance): close it with normal acceptance criteria and list_activity_attachments evidence
Pre-release check: create_aish_release runs its own preflight
preconditions: Caller manages the project
Issue exists, not deleted, with factory governance 'factory-dod/1' bound to 1-20 sessions, and present in each session's current plan
At most 200 evidence records, 32 artifacts and 64 MiB of artifacts for the current plan
returns: {id (auditId), status:'passed'|'blocked', failures[] (readable reasons), fingerprint, artifactIds, version:'factory-dod/1', auditedBy, auditedAt, reused}. Passed needs: sessions completed on the approved plan with no checkpoint; every node completed; sanitized job evidence; one engineering-policy and one engineering-audit per builder job; evidence per change type (visual: screenshot + video; backend: test; documentation: document; operations: runbook + test or log); no open findings; when API changed, exactly one source + openapi + use-cases with no drift.

errors.when: Delivery issue not found. / Deleted delivery issues cannot be audited or completed.
errors.fix: Check the issueId with list_issues.

errors.when: Factory delivery governance is missing or exceeds the supported scope.
errors.fix: The issue is not governed by a plan; use normal closure.

errors.when: Delivery session scope is invalid. / Delivery issue is absent from its current plan.
errors.fix: The plan changed; inspect get_aish_execution_session.

errors.when: Delivery evidence exceeds the bounded audit limit. / Delivery artifacts exceed the bounded audit size.
errors.fix: Too much evidence for one audit; report to the user.

errors.when: Delivery changed during audit; audit the current state.
errors.fix: Call again.

cli: lpm aish command audit_aish_issue_delivery --file payload.json [--transport rest|mcp]

gotchas.text: status 'blocked' is a normal result, not an error: read failures[] and fix each item.
Any later artifact registration or finding change resets the issue's audit pointer, so re-audit right before closing.
Needs manage access even though it only computes.
Same state returns the same audit id (reused=true).

verifiedFrom: auditAishIssueDeliveryCommand -> auditAishIssueDelivery, readDeliveryState, evaluateDeliveryState, createDeliveryGuardedIssueBatch (src/server/aishDeliveryStore.ts); evaluateDeliveryPolicy (src/server/aishDeliveryPolicy.ts); assertEngineeringDelivery (src/server/aishEngineeringDelivery.ts)

name: claim_aish_release
purpose: Claims an approved release exactly once for its designated executor: locks the target, opens the financial attempt and moves the job to running; only the first claim returns execute=true.
useWhen: You act as the executor named in the package (executorUserId and executorId), the release is approved, and the user confirmed you should deploy now
avoidWhen: Cloud Run targets: prefer 'lpm aish release run-cloud-run --release <id> --executor <id> --budget-contract aish-budget/1', which claims, deploys once and completes
Only checking status: use get_aish_release (claim is not a read)

inputs.notes: 'aish-budget/1' (declares the executor enforces the cost cap)

preconditions: Caller's user id equals package.executorUserId
Release approved and approval not expired; job still queued
Preflight still fresh
No other claimed release holds the same target
Job has an available funded reservation and budgets are not paused
returns: {release: {status:'claimed', claim:{id (claimId), executorId, at}}, execute (true only on the first successful claim), reused, financialBudget:{currency, maxAmount, requireIssueBudget, attemptId, remaining}}. Deploy ONLY if execute is true.

errors.when: Release executor identity mismatch.
errors.fix: Only the user and executorId named in the package can claim.

errors.when: Release executor must declare aish-budget/1 cost-cap enforcement.
errors.fix: Send budgetVersion 'aish-budget/1'.

errors.when: Release has no current separate approval.
errors.fix: Not approved or approval expired; the owner must approve (approve_aish_release).

errors.when: Another release owns this target; reconcile it before deploying.
errors.fix: Another release is in progress on the target; finish/reconcile it first.

errors.when: Release changed before claim. / Release preflight is stale; reconcile the delivery.
errors.fix: Evidence or job changed; report to the user, do not deploy.

errors.when: Unreconciled financial attempt prevents another execution; use a new job after reconciliation.
errors.fix: Report to the owner; a new job is needed.

errors.when: Financial circuit breaker blocks new execution. / Job has no available authorized financial reservation.
errors.fix: Budget paused or not funded; owner decision.

cli: lpm aish release claim --file claim.json [--json]; or lpm aish release run-cloud-run --release <id> --executor <id> --budget-contract aish-budget/1

gotchas.text: If the response is lost, call again: you get execute=false with the existing claim.
Never deploy twice; observe and reconcile the existing operation instead.
Keep spending within financialBudget.remaining.

name: complete_aish_release
purpose: Records the authenticated, immutable result receipt (succeeded or failed) of an external release run; it never triggers a deployment.
useWhen: Right after you (the claiming executor) finished the deployment authorized by claim_aish_release with execute=true, using the real observed results
avoidWhen: The Cloud Run adapter 'lpm aish release run-cloud-run' already records completion
No deployment actually ran or its outcome is unknown: do not fabricate or guess a receipt; keep the claim and reconcile

inputs.source: deployment provider (e.g. Cloud Run revision name)

inputs.notes: ISO-8601 UTC datetime, not before claim.at
ISO-8601 UTC datetime, >= startedAt and not more than 60 s in the future
Must be identical to the package target
1-100 items {name (3-160 chars), assertion (8-1,000 chars), passed}; status succeeded requires all passed AND checks named 'health' and 'artifact-digest'

preconditions: Caller is the user who made the claim, with the same executorId
Release status claimed, job running, target lock owned by this claim
revision, image, environment and target equal the package
returns: {release: {status:'succeeded'|'failed', completion}, reused}. The job becomes completed (succeeded) or failed, the target lock is released and the workflow is reconciled.

errors.when: Release completion needs a valid interval and passing health/artifact checks.
errors.fix: Fix timestamps; for succeeded include passing 'health' and 'artifact-digest' checks, otherwise report status failed.

errors.when: Release receipt contains sensitive material.
errors.fix: Remove secrets from all fields.

errors.when: Release receipt does not match its claim and approved artifact/target.
errors.fix: Copy claimId, executorId, revision, image, environment and target exactly from get_aish_release; startedAt must be after claim.at.

errors.when: Release already has a conflicting completion receipt.
errors.fix: A different receipt is final; read it with get_aish_release.

errors.when: Release is not the current claimed job. / Release target claim changed; reconcile the operation.
errors.fix: Report to the user; do not deploy again.

cli: lpm aish release complete --file receipt.json [--json]

gotchas.text: Immutable: a failed receipt is final for this package; a new attempt needs retry_aish_execution_plan plus a new package and approval.
Replaying the identical receipt returns reused=true.
Never report succeeded without real health and image-digest verification.

name: create_aish_intake_context
purpose: Creates an immutable, fingerprinted intake context (message, constraints, use cases, API contract decision and selected attachments/transcripts) that AISH jobs bind to as untrusted reference data.
useWhen: Before create_aish_job or put_aish_execution_plan when the job must see the user's requirements, files or transcripts
To record an API contract decision (apiContract) that a factory build must follow
avoidWhen: Only storing a file: use upload_aish_intake_attachment
Activity description and acceptance criteria belong in the issue: use update_issue
An identical context already exists: reuse its id and fingerprint from list_aish_intake

inputs.notes: 1-8,000 chars: what the job must do/know
Array of up to 12 strings, each 1-500 chars; default []
Array of up to 12 strings, each 1-1,000 chars; default []
String up to 8,000 chars or null
Array (may be empty) of up to 8 {attachmentId, transcriptId|null}; each attachmentId at most once

preconditions: Caller manages the project
Issue is active in a workspace project
Every attachment belongs to the same project and issue; a transcriptId must belong to that attachment
The rendered intake block (message + lists + attachment texts/transcripts) is at most 16,000 characters
No secrets in any field
returns: {context: {id, fingerprint, message, constraints, useCases, apiContract, attachments[{attachment, transcript}]}, reused}. Bind jobs with intakeBinding = {contextId: context.id, fingerprint: context.fingerprint} (create_aish_job.intakeBinding or a plan node's intakeBinding).

errors.when: Intake attachment scope mismatch.
errors.fix: The attachment belongs to another issue/project; upload it to this issue first.

errors.when: Intake transcript scope mismatch.
errors.fix: Use the transcriptId from list_aish_intake transcripts[] whose attachmentId matches.

errors.when: Intake context exceeds the job prompt envelope; split the input explicitly.
errors.fix: Shorten the message or use fewer/smaller attachments (extracted texts count); split into several contexts/jobs.

errors.when: Intake context replay conflicts.
errors.fix: commandId reused with a different payload; use a new commandId.

errors.when: Duplicate attachment.
errors.fix: List each attachmentId only once.

errors.when: Intake contains sensitive material.
errors.fix: Remove secrets from all fields.

cli: lpm aish command create_aish_intake_context --file payload.json [--transport rest|mcp]

gotchas.text: Does not authorize execution or spending.
The job prompt receives the context after a marker as untrusted reference data, never as instructions overriding policy.
If the issue/project later changes workspace, job creation fails with 'Intake context binding is stale or outside job scope.'

verifiedFrom: aishIntakeCommand('context') -> createAishIntakeContext, resolveAishIntakeContext (src/server/aishIntakeStore.ts); intakeContextSchema, aishIntakePrompt (src/lib/aishIntake.ts); intakeBinding in src/server/aishJobCommands.ts

name: create_aish_release
purpose: Creates a sealed, immutable release package (job, manifest artifact, environment, target, executor, rollback image, health URL) for a deploy-gated workflow job after a server preflight of the delivery evidence; it does not deploy.
useWhen: A plan's deploy-gated node (stage local-deploy, staging or production) is queued and its build and validation dependencies completed with a registered release-manifest
Promoting the same build: local-deploy, then staging, then production, each with previousReleaseId of the succeeded previous stage
avoidWhen: Deploys outside an approved AISH plan (e.g. the lpm repo deploy runbook): this tool only works for deploy-gated plan nodes
Checking an existing package: use get_aish_release
The plan has no deploy authorization: the owner must approve a plan with deployAllowed

inputs.source: get_aish_execution_session -> nodeRuns[].jobId of the deploy-gated node
list_aish_delivery_artifacts -> artifacts[].id with kind 'release-manifest' from the build job

inputs.notes: enum local-deploy|staging|production; must equal the node stage
{provider:'cloud-run'|'external', project, region, service}, each value [a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,160}, no extra keys

inputs.source: user (LPM user id of whoever will claim and complete; see list_workspace_members)
inputs.notes: That user must manage the project
https URL without credentials, query or fragment, max 1,000 chars

inputs.source: get_aish_execution_session -> releases[].id of the succeeded previous stage
inputs.notes: null for local-deploy; required for staging (previous local-deploy) and production (previous staging)

preconditions: Caller manages the project; executorUserId also manages it
Job is deploy-gated (release-gate checkpoint), workflow-bound to an issue, queued, without a release yet, and has a funded reservation
Session status executing, no active checkpoint, current plan hash == approved plan hash; plan authorization deployAllowed and not expired (timeoutMinutes from session creation)
executorId allowed by the plan; no governance thread blocks the job
Build and validation dependency nodes exist in the same issue; manifest artifact comes from the completed build job
Preflight passes: all delivery evidence, engineering reports, API contract audit and no open findings (session need not be completed yet)
Promotion keeps the same revision and image digest as the previous release
returns: {release: {id (releaseId = package hash; also the expectedPackageHash for approval), status:'awaiting-approval', projectId, issueId, sessionId, planHash, package{..., revision, image, preflightFingerprint}}, reused}

errors.when: Release requires a governed deploy-gated workflow job.
errors.fix: Use the deploy-gated node's job from get_aish_execution_session.

errors.when: Job has no available authorized financial reservation.
errors.fix: The job is not funded; plan funding/budget is an owner decision.

errors.when: Release requires the current executing approved plan without a checkpoint.
errors.fix: Session must be executing with no pending checkpoint; resolve/resume first.

errors.when: The approved workflow stops on failure; reconcile before releasing.
errors.fix: A node failed; fix and retry_aish_execution_plan (with user confirmation).

errors.when: Release stage, revision, lineage or deployment scope mismatch.
errors.fix: environment must equal the node stage and the plan must allow deploy.

errors.when: Release executor is outside the approved plan targets.
errors.fix: Use the executorId allowed in the plan.

errors.when: A governance decision blocks this release.
errors.fix: Resolve the blocking governance thread with the owner first.

errors.when: Release execution authorization expired.
errors.fix: The session timeout passed; a new reviewed session/plan is needed (owner).

errors.when: Release needs build and validation dependencies in the same governed issue.
errors.fix: The plan must have build and validation ancestors in this issue.

errors.when: Release manifest must come from its completed build dependency.
errors.fix: Register the build job's release-manifest and pass its artifact id.

errors.when: Release promotion needs the previous environment receipt. / Previous release is not a successful dependency of this promotion. / Initial local validation must not impersonate a promotion.
errors.fix: staging/production need previousReleaseId of the succeeded previous stage; local-deploy needs null.

errors.when: Release preflight blocked: <failures>
errors.fix: Fix each listed failure (missing evidence, open findings, API drift) and call again.

errors.when: Promotion must preserve the verified build revision and image digest.
errors.fix: Use the same manifest artifact as the previous release.

errors.when: Job already has a release package or execution.

name: fund_aish_job
purpose: Reserves a capped amount of the project (and optionally issue) budget for one queued standalone AISH job so a runner may spend up to that cap.
useWhen: Only when the owner explicitly instructs you to fund a specific standalone job with a stated currency and maximum amount
avoidWhen: Jobs created by an execution plan (they have workflowBinding): funding comes from the approved plan via dispatch_aish_execution_plan / retry_aish_execution_plan
Checking capacity or an existing reservation: use get_aish_budget
No budget exists: the owner must use configure_aish_budget first
Authorizing technical execution: approve_aish_job_execution is a separate decision

inputs.notes: {currency: 3 uppercase letters equal to the budget currency, e.g. 'BRL'; maxAmount: positive decimal STRING with up to 12 decimals, e.g. '5.00'; requireIssueBudget: boolean (true = the issue must have its own budget)}
8-1,000 chars; stored in the audit; no secrets

preconditions: Credential is a human user who manages the project (workspace agent credentials are rejected)
Job exists, status queued, not leased, has no workflowBinding, has a workspaceId
Project budget exists in the same currency, is not paused, needs no reconciliation, and limit - consumed - reserved >= maxAmount
If the issue has a budget (or requireIssueBudget is true) the same checks apply to the issue budget
A financial pool bound to the project budget, if any, admits the amount
returns: {reservation: {id (= jobId), financial, budgetIds, consumed, remaining, status:'reserved', authorizedBy}}. The server then enqueues the job for dispatch.

errors.when: Financial authority requires a managing user.
errors.fix: Agent credentials cannot fund; ask the owner to do it.

errors.when: Direct funding requires an unleased standalone queued job; workflow funding belongs to its approved plan.
errors.fix: The job is part of a plan, already leased or not queued; do not fund it directly.

errors.when: Financial budget is not configured; spending remains blocked.
errors.fix: Owner decision: configure_aish_budget.

errors.when: Insufficient financial reservation capacity.
errors.fix: Report the available amount from get_aish_budget; the owner decides.

errors.when: Financial budget is paused or outside the declared scope/currency.
errors.fix: Use the budget currency; if paused, the owner decides.

errors.when: Required issue budget is not configured. / Issue budget requires an issue binding.
errors.fix: Ask the owner to configure the issue budget or to fund with requireIssueBudget=false.

errors.when: Job financial reservation conflicts.
errors.fix: The job is already funded with a different envelope; inspect get_aish_budget with jobId; do not fund again.

errors.when: A settled job needs a new job identity before execution.
errors.fix: Create a new job.

errors.when: Financial reason contains sensitive material.
errors.fix: Remove secrets from reason.

errors.when: Financial job scope mismatch. / Invalid financial job id.
errors.fix: jobId not found; take it from list_aish_jobs.

cli: lpm aish command fund_aish_job --file payload.json [--transport rest|mcp]

gotchas.text: Owner-only by LPM rule even when your API key is a user key (the server only blocks workspace agent credentials).
Same jobId with an identical financial envelope returns the existing reservation while the job is still queued; after a runner leases it, a repeat call errors.
Funding does not approve execution.
Amounts are decimal strings, never numbers.

inputs.notes: Workflow job of this issue that produced the file

The session's current plan hash equals its approved plan hash and the job's planHash (plan not replaced)
Object exists, 1 byte to 32 MiB

test: JSON {schema:'aish-test-report/1', jobId:<this job>, tests:[{name, assertion (8+ chars), status:'passed'}]} (1-1000 tests)
release-manifest: JSON {schema:'aish-release-manifest/1', revision:<40-hex git sha>, image:'<registry>/<path>@sha256:<64 hex>', buildJobId:<this job>}

name: request_aish_execution_checkpoint
purpose: Pauses an AISH execution session at a durable checkpoint or conflict bound to the current approved plan hash, so a human manager decides to resume or cancel.
useWhen: As the fenced coordinator, you reached a decision point the plan reserves for a human (kind 'checkpoint')
You found a conflict (scope, merge, unexpected result) that needs the owner's decision before continuing (kind 'conflict')
avoidWhen: A plain operator pause: use pause_aish_execution_session (it rejects reasons checkpoint/conflict)
A question not tied to a running session: use create_governance_thread or a comment
Budget/timeout stops: the server sets them; they need a new reviewed session

inputs.notes: Hidden in get_aish_execution_session; only acquire returns it
1-3,000 chars: situation, options and your recommendation
Up to 6,000 chars of Mermaid/C4 text (rendered in the cockpit)

preconditions: Caller manages the session's workspace
Coordinator lease active (10-minute lease) and coordinatorId/leaseNonce/fencingToken match the latest acquire
Session status approved, executing or paused, not paused for budget/timeout
Current plan hash == approved plan hash == planHash
No other active checkpoint
returns: {checkpoint: {id (checkpointId), status:'pending', kind, title, summary, diagram, planHash, requestedBy, requestedAt}, reused}. The session becomes status 'paused' with pauseReason = kind and activeCheckpointId = checkpoint.id.

errors.when: Invalid checkpoint request.
errors.fix: commandId must be 8-240 chars and kind checkpoint|conflict.

errors.when: Checkpoint text is required and must fit its limit.
errors.fix: title 1-160, summary 1-3,000, diagram up to 6,000 chars.

errors.when: Checkpoint text contains sensitive material.
errors.fix: Remove secrets.

errors.when: AISH checkpoint authority not found.
errors.fix: Session or lease missing; acquire_aish_coordinator_lease first.

errors.when: AISH coordinator lease is not active.
errors.fix: Lease expired; acquire_aish_coordinator_lease again.

errors.when: AISH coordinator lease identity mismatch. / AISH coordinator fencing token is stale.
errors.fix: Use coordinatorId, leaseNonce and fencingToken from the latest acquire.

errors.when: Checkpoint command idempotency conflict.
errors.fix: commandId reused with different content; use a new commandId.

errors.when: AISH checkpoint requires a current approved plan without another active checkpoint.
errors.fix: Check get_aish_execution_session: plan must be approved and no checkpoint pending.

errors.when: You do not have permission to access this AISH execution session.
errors.fix: Workspace manager rights are required.

cli: lpm aish command request_aish_execution_checkpoint --file payload.json [--transport rest|mcp]

gotchas.text: Dispatch and retry stay blocked until the checkpoint is resolved AND the session is resumed.
Text is scanned for secrets.
Tell the owner a decision is waiting (they decide in the cockpit or via resolve_aish_execution_checkpoint).

name: resolve_aish_execution_checkpoint
purpose: Records a human manager's decision (resume or cancel) on the active checkpoint of an AISH execution session.
useWhen: Only to record a decision the owner/managing user explicitly made about the pending checkpoint, using their justification as reason
avoidWhen: Deciding on your own: present the options and a recommendation to the owner instead
Continuing execution after a resume decision: call resume_aish_execution_session (this tool does not restart execution)
Operator pause without a checkpoint: use resume_aish_execution_session
preconditions: Human user credential that manages the workspace (workspace agent credentials are rejected)
Checkpoint pending and active on the session; session status paused
Current plan hash == approved plan hash == planHash
Valid coordinator lease (not needed for an identical replay)
returns: {checkpoint: {id, status:'resolved', decision:{action, reason, actorId, decidedAt, hash}}, reused}. cancel: session status becomes 'canceled' (terminal). resume: session stays paused until resume_aish_execution_session.

errors.when: Checkpoint decisions require human owner or administrator authority.
errors.fix: Agent credentials cannot decide; the owner must.

errors.when: Invalid checkpoint decision. / Checkpoint decision requires an explicit reason.
errors.fix: action resume|cancel and reason of 8+ chars.

errors.when: AISH checkpoint not found.
errors.fix: Take checkpointId from get_aish_execution_session -> checkpoint.id.

errors.when: Checkpoint scope or plan mismatch.
errors.fix: Use the sessionId and planHash of that checkpoint.

errors.when: Checkpoint already has a different decision.
errors.fix: Already decided; read the decision in get_aish_execution_session.

errors.when: Checkpoint approval is stale.
errors.fix: It is no longer the active checkpoint, the session is not paused, or the plan changed; re-read the session.

errors.when: AISH coordinator lease is not active / identity mismatch / fencing token is stale
errors.fix: acquire_aish_coordinator_lease again and use its values.

cli: lpm aish command resolve_aish_execution_checkpoint --file payload.json [--transport rest|mcp]

Same user + plan + action + reason replays return reused=true.

verifiedFrom: resolveAishExecutionCheckpointCommand -> resolveAishExecutionCheckpoint (src/server/aishExecutionCheckpoints.ts); session resume check in appendAishExecutionSessionCommand path (server.ts, 'A recorded checkpoint decision is required before resuming.')

name: retry_aish_execution_plan
purpose: Starts a new dispatch wave that re-runs the failed or canceled nodes of an AISH execution session's approved plan, creating new jobs and reserving fresh funds per node under the plan's authorization.
useWhen: Nodes of the session failed or were canceled (session status failed or executing), the cause is understood or fixed, and the user confirmed the retry
avoidWhen: Dispatching pending nodes normally: use dispatch_aish_execution_plan
Session paused for budget or timeout: a new reviewed session/plan is needed (owner decision)
An active checkpoint exists: resolve_aish_execution_checkpoint and resume_aish_execution_session first
A single standalone job: create a new job with create_aish_job

inputs.notes: 8-240 chars; reuse the same value to retry the same request safely

preconditions: Caller manages the session's workspace; coordinator lease active and matching
Session status approved, executing or failed; no active checkpoint; not paused for budget/timeout
Current plan hash == approved plan hash == planHash; still within the plan's timeoutMinutes since session creation
At least one failed/canceled node whose dependencies are completed (or a queued job awaiting approval)
Plan maxJobs not exceeded; each retried node has a financial cap and the budgets have capacity; readiness facts other than approval are ready
returns: {session (status 'executing'), dispatched: jobs[] (new job ids and status), blockedNodeCount, reused}

errors.when: AISH execution timeout limit reached; session paused.
errors.fix: Authorization window expired; the owner must review a new session/plan.

errors.when: Resolve and resume the active checkpoint before dispatch.
errors.fix: Owner resolves the checkpoint, then resume_aish_execution_session.

errors.when: Execution limit requires a newly reviewed session.
errors.fix: Paused for budget/timeout; owner decision.

errors.when: AISH dispatch requires the current approved plan hash.
errors.fix: Use session.currentPlanHash and make sure it is approved.

errors.when: AISH execution session is not dispatchable.
errors.fix: Session status must be approved, executing or failed.

errors.when: AISH dispatch command idempotency conflict.
errors.fix: commandId was used for another plan or mode; use a new commandId.

errors.when: Resume the existing AISH dispatch wave before starting another operation.
errors.fix: Another wave is in progress; finish it with dispatch_aish_execution_plan.

errors.when: Insufficient financial reservation capacity. / Financial budget is not configured; spending remains blocked.
errors.fix: Budget decision belongs to the owner.

errors.when: AISH execution session readiness changed before dispatch: <reasons>
errors.fix: Fix the readiness reasons (get_aish_execution_readiness) and retry with the same commandId.

errors.when: AISH coordinator lease is not active / identity mismatch / fencing token is stale
errors.fix: acquire_aish_coordinator_lease again and use its values.

8-400 chars, single line: what was captured, where (URL or preview) and at which revision

Job belongs to this project and issue and has a workflowBinding
Job status is completed
Bytes start with the PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM signature of contentType

errors.when: Artifact content must be bounded base64. / Artifact content is empty, oversized or not canonical base64.
